trap.label: conector
trap.wrong: Despite the team lost, the fans cheered.
trap.right: Although the team lost, the fans cheered.
trap.why: Em português “apesar de” aceita oração (“apesar de o time ter perdido”). Em inglês despite exige substantivo ou -ing; com sujeito + verbo use although.

fix.wrong: Despite of the heat, we hiked.
Although it was cheap but I skipped it.
fix.right: Although it was cheap, I skipped it.

rewrite.prompt: Use despite: “It snowed. We drove.” (the snow)
